title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Stocks reversed lower Monday as the AI selloff continued — Nasdaq -1.1%, S&P 500 -0.5% — while the Dow eked out +0.4% on rotation into housing/old-economy names (Home Depot, Walmart, Sherwin-Williams).
Markets: Oil cratered ~7.6% (Brent to ~$105) on reports Trump won't rush fresh Iran strikes after the midterms; the 10-year Treasury yield slid to 4.89%.

Companies: Marvell agreed to buy optics maker Lumentum for ~$80B in an all-stock AI deal; both stocks fell hard (Marvell -13%, Lumentum -19%) on dilution and premium worries. CoreWeave and Oracle each sank ~9% in the broader AI pullback.
Companies: Anthropic's updated IPO filing disclosed ~$895B in compute purchase/lease commitments; Q3 revenue hit $17B, up from $1.4B a year earlier.
Macro/Policy: Today's US midterm election results are the next big market catalyst, with investors watching for signs of a divided Congress.
Macro/Policy: Wednesday brings AMD, Amgen and Pfizer earnings plus September JOLTS job-openings data.
